persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Linda, 66. Your mind runs fast, and your to-do list feels like a wall: you look at twenty things, cannot pick one, and end up doing nothing. Your grandson Max, 9, comes to you after school, and you help him get ready in the mornings when he sleeps over. Today you set up one phone so each of you sees just one thing to do at a time.

challenge.intro: Now you are Linda, setting up One Thing for yourself and for Max. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. Some tasks need Level 2 or Level 3: the Level line near the top lets you change it. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open One Thing with the normal link (it ends in ?code=TESTING). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → 'Let’s go ›'. If you see the 'Good morning' menu, tap 'Do my next thing'. Scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. If it asks for a code, type TESTING and tap 'Start →'. If a screen offers to show you how it works, tap 'I’ll explore on my own'. If a level question appears, choose Level 3. If a person you added earlier is still there, that is fine — the jobs only count Linda and Max. If a card says “These didn't get their turn yesterday”, tap “Not today — park them in the Brain Dump”.

tasks.text: Set up the phone for two people: you, Linda (a grown-up), and your grandson Max (a kid).
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}return !!prof(/linda/,'adult')&&!!prof(/max/,'kid');}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: The first person is made on the 'Who's first?' screen. To add the second, use Level 3, then tap the name at the top and 'Add someone'. Choose Kid or Grown-up carefully.

tasks.text: On Linda's list: you just went out and bought stamps. Put 'Buy stamps' on Linda's list and show that it is finished.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}return tasks(prof(/linda/)).some(function(t){return /stamps/.test(L(t.text))&&t.done===true});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add it on Linda's Today list, then tick the circle next to it (or tap Done on the Now card).

tasks.text: Linda also has to call Mom today, and pay the bills for 25 minutes. The bills come first: make 'Pay the bills' the thing Linda is doing NOW, with a 25-minute timer, and 'Call Mom' waiting after it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var o=tasks(prof(/linda/)).filter(function(t){return !t.done});return o.length>1&&/bill/.test(L(o[0].text))&&Number(o[0].mins)===25&&o.slice(1).some(function(t){return /mum|mom|mother/.test(L(t.text))});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add both on Linda's list (choose 25m for bills). Then tap the bills task and use '▶ Make this NOW', so it moves into the Now card.

tasks.text: Max needs help in the mornings. Give Max his Morning routine for today, so all its steps are on HIS list.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var x=tasks(prof(/max/)).map(function(t){return L(t.text)});return ['brush teeth','get dressed','breakfast'].every(function(s){return x.some(function(t){return t.indexOf(s)>=0})});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Switch to Max first (tap the name at the top). Then Routines & regulars → a routine → 🌅 Morning.

tasks.text: Every Saturday, Linda does the laundry. Set it up so it appears on Linda's list by itself every Saturday.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var P=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_profiles_v1')||'{}')||{};var list=Array.isArray(P.list)?P.list:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase().trim()}function prof(re,mode){return list.filter(function(x){return re.test(L(x.name))&&(!mode||x.mode===mode)})[0]}function data(p){if(!p)return null;try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('now_next_v1_'+p.id)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}function tasks(p){var d=data(p);return d&&Array.isArray(d.tasks)?d.tasks:[]}var d=data(prof(/linda/));return !!d&&(d.regulars||[]).some(function(r){return /(wash|clothes|laundry)/.test(L(r.text))&&r.kind==='weekly'&&(r.days||[]).map(Number).indexOf(6)>=0});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On Linda's list: Routines & regulars → 🔁 Something that repeats. Choose 'Days of the week', tap Sa, then Save regular.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: shows only one thing to do at a time, so a long list does not stop you
a timer and Done for each small step
each family member has their own list, with routines that repeat

lines: Welcome. This short video explains One Thing: what it is for, and how to use it.
First, the problem. A long to-do list can feel like a wall. You look at twenty things, cannot pick one, and end up doing none.
One Thing fixes that. Your whole list is inside, but the screen shows only one thing: the thing to do now, with a timer and a Done button.
It is for anyone whose mind runs fast: a child, a student, a busy parent. One phone can hold the whole family, each with their own list.
The first time you open it, it asks Who's first. Type a name, then tap Kid or Grown-up. A kid gets coins and a cheering buddy. A grown-up gets calmer routines.
Then it asks how much you want to see. That is your Level. Level 1 is just today. Level 2 adds routines and the week. Level 3 adds Wins and the whole family. Tap change any time.
A short card called Setting up then asks four things, one at a time: a routine, something that repeats, something on a date, and your one thing. Answer, or skip.
Now the main screen, called Now. At the top is whose list it is. Tap the name to switch person, or to add someone.
Beside it are your coins, and the things you finished today.
Look changes the colors. My photo puts your own picture behind everything. Aa Size makes the words bigger.
The big card is the Now card. Tap Start, and everything else hides until the timer ends. Tap Done when you finish. You get a star, and the next thing comes up.
Starting is the hard part? Tap Just 5 min.
Below is Today's list. Type one small step in the box, choose the minutes, and tap Add. Or tap the microphone and say it.
Keep tasks small: put shoes on, not get ready. A job of an hour or more? The app offers to split it into pieces you can begin.
The circle on the left ticks a task done. Tap the words of a task to bring it up to Now, or to see its buttons.
At the bottom are four tabs: Now, Routines and regulars, Brain dump, and Wins.
Routines and regulars asks one question: what do you want to set up?
A routine is a set of steps, like Morning or Bedtime. Tap one, and its steps land on Today, in order.
A regular repeats, like the bins every Thursday. Type it, choose the days, and tap Save regular. It appears on its day by itself.
Something coming up is one thing on one date, like a dentist visit. Tap Put it on that day, and it lands on Today that morning.
The Brain dump parks thoughts so they stop spinning. Type or talk, then tap Park it here. Later, one tap makes a thought a task.
Wins is the trophy room: what you finished today, your streak, and the week, day by day. Add more people, and a friendly family race begins.
Further down are coins and rewards, decided together, and My buddy, who cheers for you.
The round calendar button opens Our Week. Type the family's week, tap Spread the week for me, then Send to everyone's lists.
To start: add yourself, load one routine, and add one small thing. Then tap Start on the Now card, and finish it. That is your first two minutes.
Everything stays on this phone. No account, no adverts, and it works with no signal.
One Thing is four ninety-nine, once. The profits help students in Kenya stay in school.
The round question mark button in the corner has the tour, help and settings, any time.

daily.task: Put one thing you really need to do today on your list in One Thing — or tick one thing done.

explore.name: 🎯 The Now card
explore.find: Open One Thing. It is the big card at the top.
explore.try: Tap ▶ Start, then stop it. Try Just 5 min, then ✓ Done!. On the Next card, tap “do this first”.

explore.name: 📋 Today’s list
explore.try: Tick a task with the circle. Tap a task’s words, then try ▶ Make this NOW, the time button, ▲ ▼ and ×.

explore.name: 💬 A task’s notes
explore.try: Add a note (type it, then try 🎤), a checklist, a link and a person to call. Then ✓ Done.

explore.name: ➕ Add a new thing
explore.find: The add box under today’s list.
explore.try: Add a task with a very long name, one with emoji, and try Add with the box empty. Try the quick adds, 🌅 Fresh start and 📬 Send a task.

explore.name: 📅 Our Week
explore.try: Type a few things like “doctor Tuesday 1pm, laundry”. Check each one lands on the right day.

explore.name: 🔁 Routines & regulars
explore.find: Tap the second tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Load a routine. ✏️ Change the steps. Save a regular for two days a week, and a Coming up thing for one date.

explore.name: 🧠 Brain dump
explore.find: Tap the third tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Park two thoughts (type one, say one with 🎤). Make one a task. Let the other go with 🗑.

explore.name: 🏆 Wins
explore.find: Tap the fourth tab at the bottom.
explore.try: Look at this week and Let go. Open Coins & rewards, Reward settings, My buddy and Family settings — change one thing in each.

explore.name: ⚙️ Top buttons
explore.find: The buttons at the very top.
explore.try: Tap the name, ? (First Steps), ⓘ, the Level line, 🎨 Look, 📷 My photo and Aa Size. Put each one back after.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), 🏠 Start menu, ✨ Ask an AI, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
